policy.original: Reconstruct all 5m NAV with the native inclusive funding projection.
policy.shifted: Change only funding event index from native hour to original public millisecond.
policy.one_book: One public settlement per symbol and clock, hourly funding mark held fixed, use frozen quantities before or after fills exactly at the public millisecond.
policy.bound: For the one-book envelope only, any saved fill between nominal hour and exact public time can fall on either side of the assumed position cutoff.
policy.observation: One-book cash at the first observed 5m clock strictly after the public event. This is a diagnostic sample convention, not historical receipt.
policy.retained: Fixed fills, fees, risk flags and marks. No strategy, orders or account creation.
